description: Builds the design-system artifact folder (build/design-system, ignored) from @catch/web-ui: the bundle the canvas mounts with React 18, web-ui's static Storybook, each card's guideline and Contract-story preview, fonts, the tokens pipeline's artifact tokens and a manifest of every file's and input's hash. --check rebuilds into a temporary folder and fails on a broken build, a missing guideline or system-name alias, a preview whose story is missing, a hash mismatch, or a stale build/design-system; --compare lists differences from another artifact folder. docs/design_system_publishing.md owns the loop.
